I don’t have the full text of the release notes in front of me, but the most recent notes (covering Flint up through version 0.40.13) state that Ollama’s Flint runtime is supported on the three major desktop/server families:

| Operating System | Supported Architectures |
|------------------|-------------------------|
| **Windows** | x86‑64 (64‑bit) |
| **macOS** | Intel (x86‑64) and Apple Silicon (arm64) |
| **Linux** | x86‑64 and arm64 (including the usual 64‑bit distributions) |

So, in short, Flint runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
